dedupe_keys.name: automated photovoltaic forecasts with limited information using an ensemble of pre trained models autopv

description: Automated photovoltaic forecasts with limited information using an ensemble of pre-trained models (AutoPV) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Karlsruhe Institute of Technology; Institute for Automation and Applied Informatics. PV power generation forecasting. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: forecasting, photovoltaic, power generation. Spatial resolution: households, power stations. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
